verdict.rationale: Capacities documents an in-app import flow (Settings > Import Content) with migration guides for Notion via a Markdown + CSV export, and guides for Obsidian (Markdown vault) and Apple Notes. The guides lean on manual prep: curating structure before export, normalizing the vault and converting first. Missing for 10: any evidence of Evernote or Roam import, documentation that links and attachments survive import, confirmation that structure is preserved automatically rather than hand-curated, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
